FROM POLICY: "Patients can apply for financial aid prior to services or after receipt of a bill. Patients can also apply for financial aid after a bill has been sent to a collection agency. There is no deadline for when a patient can request to complete a financial aid application."
FROM APPLICATION: at the bottom it says "Please complete application within 30 days."
